decision.basis: User authorized thelinep for reviewer roles and requested context-by-context review and canonicalization. This plan implements the already-approved logical invariants without changing their semantics.

invariants.rule: ORGANISATION requires workspace_id IS NULL; WORKSPACE requires workspace_id IS NOT NULL.

sqlite.enforcement: BEFORE INSERT and BEFORE UPDATE triggers

invariants.rule: The lower participant membership ID must be strictly less than the higher ID; equality and reversed pairs are rejected.

postgresql.enforcement: CHECK constraint over native UUID values
postgresql.name: ck_communications_direct_message_pair_order

sqlite.enforcement: BEFORE INSERT and BEFORE UPDATE triggers using case-normalized canonical UUID text ordering

invariants.rule: A direct-message mapping must reference a parent thread whose kind is direct and whose organisation, workspace, and ID match the mapping.

postgresql.enforcement: BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE mapping triggers and parent-kind/workspace immutability trigger

sqlite.enforcement: BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE mapping triggers and parent-kind/workspace immutability trigger

invariants.rule: At most one row per organisation, workspace, thread, and workspace membership may have left_at IS NULL; ended episodes remain as history and rejoining may create a new episode.
Episode identity and joined/created timestamps are immutable; left_at may transition from null to a terminal timestamp once, but an ended episode cannot be reopened or rewritten.

validation.postgresqlReview: SQL syntax and target columns checked against the generated PostgreSQL Prisma projection; runtime DB execution is outside this DRAFT review.
validation.prismaLimitation: The Prisma schema language does not represent these invariants. Keep them in migration overlays and never remove them from the logical model.
sqliteTestCases: strictly ordered and syntactically valid UUID pair
single active thread membership episode while ended history and rejoin are allowed
